description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for Git's partial clone functionality. It defines several functions to manipulate Git repositories and performs a wide array of tests related to partial cloning, object fetching, promisor features, and repository consistency checks.

methods.name: delete_object
methods.description: Removes a specific object from the Git repository by deleting its associated file within .git/objects directory.

methods.name: pack_as_from_promisor
methods.description: Creates a pack file for the current repository with the pack-objects command, and marks it as a promisor pack.

methods.name: promise_and_delete
methods.description: Creates a tag referencing a specific commit, then packs that commit as a promisor, and deletes the original object from the repository.

methods.name: repack_and_check
methods.description: Repacks the repository with specified options, then verifies the repository and specific objects still exist post-repack.
